Initial release of gws-modelarmor: filter user-generated content for safety.

- Provides CLI integration for Google Model Armor content filtering.
- Includes helper commands to sanitize user prompts and model responses.
- Supports creation of custom Model Armor templates.
- Offers documentation for browsing resources and inspecting method schemas.
- Requires prerequisites described in gws-shared for authentication and security.
